name: dev8b (small, 75 eps): CBF optimisation with alpha 0.3 (cbfmo3) on the same episodes as dev8 interim
why: dev8 interim: optimisation (alpha 0.5) matched the selection filter on topples (7 vs 6) but had fewer successes (50 vs 55) with larger changes (16.8 vs 9.8 mm median). A 30% required cut gave smaller changes offline (median 7.7 mm).
episodes: 12000-12074 (same as dev8 interim); only the new arm + a policy-alone rerun (to verify the replays match the dev8 jobs on the same Nibi H100s)
compare_to: dev8 record / cbfm / cbfmo on the same episodes
rule: Small exploratory run: if cbfmo3 topples <= cbfm + 1 and success >= cbfm - 2, propose a pre-registered final test of the optimisation filter to the user; otherwise report and discuss.
